title.narrative: HIV/AIDS - Myanmar (01-Jan-2017-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Myanmar, HIV, Save the Children Federation, Inc. (STC HQ)This program has the following goals: To increase HIV transmission and related morbidity and mortality, disability and social and economic impact in 14 states and regions in Myanmar. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: To increase effective HIV interventions to achieve 90% coverage of key affected and priority populations at higher risk, TB patients and pregnant women with prevention, testing and treatment, care and support programmes. Objective 2: To increase effective interventions to achieve universal access to prevention of TB infection and care, support, and treatment of TB for key affected populations at higher risk, people living with HIV and general populations. Objective 3: To improve health sector service delivery in the context of HIV and TB by addressing critical health system constraints. Objective 4: To increase the meaningful participation of community based organizations and people living with HIV and TB affected to ensure that social and interventions are effective and reach vulnerable and marginalized populations, including ethnic minorities
